messages:
maria: FYI after the 1.29 rollout in us-west-2 our GPU nodegroups stopped scaling. CA logs show a decoding/parsing error for NodeGroup status.
sam: paste the exact error?
maria: from cluster-autoscaler pod logs:
```
2026-03-18T09:12:03Z ERROR nodegroup_controller.go:213 parsing NodeGroup object: unknown field \"size\" in nodegroup.status; expected \"replicas\" or \"desiredSize\"
```
kai: hmm, sounds like the cloud controller changed the CRD status shape. which CRD/version are we running for aws nodepools?
maria: eks-nodepool.aws.redwood/v1beta1 (managed by infra-agent). The new controller appears to use a different status field: `replicatEDCount` instead of `size` or `desiredSize`.
jess: can we `kubectl get` one of the NodeGroup objects?
maria: sure:
```
kubectl get nodegroup gpu-pool-g5 -o yaml
apiVersion: nodepool.aws.redwood/v1beta1
kind: NodeGroup
metadata:
  name: gpu-pool-g5
spec:
  template: ...
status:
  replicates: 0
  replicatEDCount: 2 # yep, appears to be a typo from new controller
  conditions: ...
```
sam: a typo in the controller/status JSON would absolutely break the CA's strict decoding. CA wants either status.size or status.desiredSize depending on provider.
kai: autoscaler refuses to reconcile because it can’t determine group size. logs also show:
```
E0318 09:12:04.123456       1 scale.go:89] cannot determine NodeGroup current size: decoding NodeGroup failed
```
oliver: mitigation options? we need GPU scaling back quickly for peak.
jess: options i see:
- roll back cloud-controller-manager (risky during traffic)
- patch nodegroup objects to include expected fields (status shim)
- deploy a tiny controller that copies the typoed field to `status.size` or `status.desiredSize`
- patch CA to be tolerant (longer-term)
sam: rolling controller rollback is risky. small shim/controller or admission webhook looks fastest.
kai: I can write a tiny controller that watches NodeGroup CRD and sets `.status.size` from whatever variant we find. It will:
1) read `status.replicatEDCount` (handles casing/typo variants)
2) set `.status.size` to that integer if `.status.size` missing
3) also accept `replicates` or `replicatedCount` fallbacks
Will run kube-system in us-west-2 only. Low-risk, read+write status.
maria: any regional variance? we only saw it in us-west-2 so far.
oliver: eu-west-1 still on previous controller; patch only us-west-2.
jess: for short-term, we can push the shim. medium-term we need a CA change so it tolerates extra fields and common typos. open a PR.
infra-bot: created issue #4721: "autoscaler: tolerate renamed/typoed NodeGroup status fields" assigned to @sam
deploy-bot: deploy started: nodegroup-status-compat-shim v0.0.1 -> kube-system (us-west-2)
kai: deployed v0.0.1. controller logs show it patched 12 NodeGroup objects in ~3m:
```
I0318 09:56:10 controller.go:78 patched NodeGroup/gpu-pool-g5: set status.size=2
```
maria: autoscaler resumed scaling. observed scale-up from 2 -> 4 GPUs in ~6m.
sam: follow-ups:
- PR to cluster-autoscaler to accept `replicatEDCount`/`replicatedCount`/`replicates` as fallback (I'll start)
- add an upgrade CI test that deploys new cloud-controller and verifies CA behavior
- add ops playbook for schema drift/CRD shape changes
jess: also notify platform customers in us-west-2 about a brief window of scaling instability during controller rollout.
oliver: we should write a short incident note/postmortem after CA PR merges.
maria: kai, please include unit tests in shim for variants: `replicates`, `replicatEDCount`, `replicatedCount` and push the shim manifest to infra-repo.
kai: on it. will link PR + manifest here in ~20m.
deploy-bot: deploy complete: nodegroup-status-compat-shim v0.0.1 -> kube-system (us-west-2) :white_check_mark:
maria: closing thread for now. reopen if anything else pops up.
